title.zh-TW: 以現金支付包裝運送費
title.en: Pay packing and delivery costs in cash

summary.zh-TW: 以現金 {{money:param.amount}} 支付商品的包裝與運送費用。
summary.en: Pay {{money:param.amount}} in cash for packing and delivering goods to customers.

message.zh-TW: 帳上現金不夠付這筆款項。
message.en: There is not enough cash on the books for this payment.

explanation.zh-TW: 把商品送到客戶手上的包裝與運費是銷售的費用，列在銷管費用，不計入存貨成本；進貨時的運費才會計入存貨。現金同時減少，列在營業活動的支付營業費用。
explanation.en: Packing and freight for delivering goods to customers are selling costs and belong to distribution costs and administrative expenses; they are not added to inventory, unlike freight on purchases. Cash falls at the same time and appears under operating activities as cash paid for operating expenses.
